sharedCompilerOwnerBinding.reason: Reuse immutable Phase126 FID/owner map because checked SSA changes only descriptor capability 1 to 5; attribution independently validates every linked FID pointer.

limitations: No new target programs executed; this is an offline join of completed captures.
Raw and period-weighted shares retain unknown samples; individual short captures remain low precision.
Diagnostic context/counter runtimes are not clean performance measurements.
Active dispatch identifies execution context, not inclusive ancestry or allocation origin.
Entry-segment dispatch counts count named factory/direct entries, not all source-level calls or inlined iterations.
Original Phase126 ownership is reused only under explicit capability-only SSA comparison and exact linked FID checks.
No original owner maps, runtime events or raw sample vectors are duplicated.
